howtos.title: Run a few well-onboarded bots, not a big team
howtos.what: poteto's tips for setting up a small team of AI agents that work consistently.
copy: Keep a few good bots rather than a large team; they are easier to manage.
As you explain how to do tasks, tell the bots to create skills for themselves so they stay consistent.
Give bots connectors and access to the tools you use; let them set up their own email and accounts for separation.
Describe your work as you would onboard an intern, and ask how the bot can automate it.
Brain dump by voice or transcription, then ask the bot to restate it in its own words to confirm it understood.
howtos.whenToUse: When you set up personal AI agents and want them to handle recurring work reliably.

howtos.title: Rebuild a reference website with a Claude Code /goal prompt
howtos.what: One prompt that has Claude Code remake a chosen site using Ruben Hassid's public remake repo.
copy: /goal Remake [THE WEBSITE URL YOU CHOSE] with github .com/rubenhassid1/remake until its report says REMAKE COMPLETE, or stop after 100 turns.
howtos.whenToUse: When you want a quick prototype modeled on a site you admire; the repo was not independently tested.
